payload.answer: Andrew Wilkie has repeatedly argued for mandatory pre-commitment on poker machines. In 2023 he told the House that "the pokies industry has been allowed to prey on vulnerable Australians for far too long" and called for $1 maximum bets. He has also pressed for a national gambling regulator.

sources.title: Gambling Harm — Andrew Wilkie
sources.speaker: Andrew Wilkie
sources.snippet: I rise again on gambling harm. The pokies industry has been allowed to prey on vulnerable Australians for far too long, and it is time this parliament acted with $1 maximum bets and mandatory pre-commitment on every machine.

sources.title: National Gambling Regulator — Andrew Wilkie
sources.speaker: Andrew Wilkie
sources.snippet: What we need is a national gambling regulator with teeth, and pre-commitment that is mandatory, not voluntary.

sources.title: Matters of Public Importance — Andrew Wilkie
sources.speaker: Andrew Wilkie
sources.snippet: The online wagering industry is the next frontier of harm.
